question: Who is your app for?
hint: If it is for both staff and the public, choose the public.

options.label: Members of the public
options.reason: You said your app is for the public.

options.label: Government staff only
options.reason: You said your app is only for government staff.

label: A website or web app
hint: People open it in a web browser. Do not tick this if people reach your app only through another system.
noReason: You said your app is not a website or a web app.

label: Sign-in
hint: With a password, Singpass or a work account.
noReason: You said sign-in is not part of your app.

label: SMS text messages
hint: For example one-time passwords or reminders.
noReason: You said SMS text messages to the public are not part of your app.

label: Its own web address
noReason: You said your app has no web address of its own.

label: Shortened links
hint: Links that your app shows or sends, which redirect to a longer address.
noReason: You said shortened links are not part of your app.

question: Is generative AI part of your app, for example a chatbot or a text summary?

options.label: No
options.reason: You said generative AI is not part of your app.

label: It calls an AI service that another company runs
hint: For example a model API from a cloud or AI provider.
noReason: You said your app does not call an AI service that another company runs.

label: That AI service runs overseas
noReason: You said no AI service that your app uses runs overseas.

label: That AI service runs in Singapore
noReason: You said no AI service that your app uses runs in Singapore.

hint: It runs on servers or containers that you manage.

hint: You download its files, for example from Hugging Face.
